<b>Text markieren:</b> Werkzeug <i>„Mark: Highlight text: select the “Highlight” tool, then drag the mouse over the words – exactly the text is highlighted, even across several lines; a click highlights a single word. Next to it, choose the color (yellow, green, blue, pink, orange) and the style: Highlight, Underline or Strikethrough. A selected highlight can be recolored or deleted with Del. Dragging on an empty area highlights a region (e.g. an image). All occurrences at once: Ctrl+F, enter the term, “Highlight all” – every occurrence in the whole document is highlighted, including phrases such as “November 15”; Ctrl+Z undoes them all. When saving, these become real PDF highlights: other PDF programs show them as comments with the highlighted text and can remove them.
